notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for transportation-handle identity across an additional-FOM join. The source uses only the official RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the rich base FOM, additional FOM module, transportation names, provider package, endpoint, and callback configuration. It verifies that existing transportation handles remain stable, that the newly composed transportation receives one shared handle, and that all handles round-trip through the standard name lookup services without asserting provider-specific allocation, registries, or headers.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador createFederationExecution, joinFederationExecution(additionalFomModules), getTransportationTypeHandle, getTransportationTypeName, resignFederationExecution, and destroyFederationExecution
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador FOM composition and transportation lookup declarations
